Mountain West regular season & [[2013 Mountain West Conference men's basketball tournament|tournament]] champions |bowl=NCAA Tournament |bowl_result = round of 64 }} {{2012–13 Mountain West Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2012–13 New Mexico Lobos men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of New Mexico]] as a member of the [[Mountain West Conference]] during the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Lobos were coached by sixth-year head coach [[Steve Alford]] and played their home games at [[The Pit (arena)|The Pit]] in [[Albuquerque]], [[New Mexico]]. They finish with a record of 29–6 overall and 13–3 in Mountain West play to win the Mountain West regular season championship. They were also champions of the [[2013 Mountain West Conference men's basketball tournament|Mountain West tournament]], defeating UNLV in the championship game, to earn an automatic bid to the [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2013 NCAA tournament]]. In the tournament, they were upset by [[2012–13 Harvard Crimson men's basketball team|Harvard]] in the first round. On March 20, head coach Steve Alford signed a 10-year contract extension.{{Cite web |url=http://www.wtae.com/sports/CBK-Roundup-Alford-gets-10-year-extension-Big-East-confirms-changes/-/9681176/19401824/-/ql6voez/-/index.html |title=CBK Roundup: Alford gets 10-year extension, Big East confirms changes | Sports - WTAE Home |access-date=2013-04-09 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130630165241/http://www.wtae.com/sports/CBK-Roundup-Alford-gets-10-year-extension-Big-East-confirms-changes/-/9681176/19401824/-/ql6voez/-/index.html |archive-date=2013-06-30 |url-status=dead }} However, on April 2 Alford resigned to take the head coaching job at [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball|UCLA]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.santafenewmexican.com/sports/lobos/article_fb9a0329-6d00-57b9-b3fe-e5772de35ee0.html|title = Alford leaves UNM for UCLA despite 10-year contract extension}} ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
